decisions.reason: Location-based margin analysis draws directly on the firm's maintained tariff and market-data databases, so the firm can interpret customer feedback and refine it with its own R&D, and it fits the central platform strategy.

Gas tariff comparison is close to the core offer and relies on established data-capture and calculation know-how, so keeping it carries little risk and strong absorptive capacity supports its improvement.
The regional electricity tariff calculator has its own page and is a close extension of established competencies, so the firm can readily assimilate market feedback and keep developing it.
This multi-model tariff calculator line builds on the firm's knowledge base, but its low website visibility and overlap with C leave some chance of consolidation, so it is kept for now.
The area definition tool uses the firm's regional and network data expertise and supports its other location-based products, which makes it a useful building block for the integrated platform.
Site-specific tariff comparison draws on existing databases and core know-how, although its limited website visibility and overlap with B mean a modest chance it is merged into another product.
